profile.summary:
As a talented and motivated Full Stack Software Engineer and Ethical AI Trainer, I deliver what’s in demand today - where software engineering and AI cross-pollinate.

With conscientious focus, I deliver on clients’ needs by possessing articulate written and verbal communication skills (EFL) coupled with a keen ability to ‘read the room’ and manage interactions.

Being an early adopter of AI LLMs, I leverage them to gain valuable insights and competitive advantages in product design. My familiarity with the architecture and operation of LLMs enables me to produce creative prompts with the AIs potential output in mind.

I am a motivated self-starter and cooperative team member who possesses outstanding emotional intelligence. My ability to understand and manage my own emotions, as well as showing genuine empathy towards my team members, allows me to foster a positive and productive work environment for all.

I’m excited about bringing over 15 years of solutions to the table at your organization.

“Here’s what I can do for you (...).”
                      

"If you affect change by starting with the early adopters, the majority won’t just go along with it - they'll demand it." - Simon Sinek
